saw_lines: Readers rarely buy a magazine on impulse. They subscribe when the price beats the newsstand and the issue feels worth keeping.
So the subscribe decision is made in the first line, before a reader decides the piece is not for them.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 2 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
ads_1: Paid creative opening on the subscribe and save offer, tested against two current stories
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, X and YouTube
